description: Implementation of the 'Cord' class for efficient string handling in the Abseil library, including functions for creating, manipulating, and comparing cord objects, as well as internal node management and validation.

classes.name: Cord
classes.description: Main class representing a string-like object with efficient concatenation and slicing capabilities.

classes.name: Cord::InlineRep
classes.description: Internal class managing inline storage of small strings within a Cord object.

classes.name: Cord::ChunkIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing chunks within a Cord.

methods.name: Cord::Cord
methods.description: Constructs a Cord from a string view or string, choosing inline or tree representation.

methods.name: Cord::DestroyCordSlow
methods.description: Destructor logic for cleaning up Cord objects.

methods.name: Cord::Clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of the Cord.

methods.name: Cord::AssignLargeString
methods.description: Assigns a large string to the Cord, creating an external representation.

methods.name: Cord::operator=
methods.description: Assigns a string view to the Cord, optimizing for inline or tree storage.

methods.name: Cord::Append
methods.description: Appends another Cord or string to this Cord.

methods.name: Cord::Prepend
methods.description: Prepends another Cord or string to this Cord.

methods.name: Cord::RemovePrefix
methods.description: Removes a prefix of specified size from the Cord.

methods.name: Cord::RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix of specified size from the Cord.

methods.name: Cord::Subcord
methods.description: Returns a subview (slice) of the Cord.

methods.name: Cord::Compare
methods.description: Compares the Cord with a string view or another Cord.

methods.name: Cord::EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if the Cord ends with a given string or Cord.

methods.name: Cord::operator std::string
methods.description: Converts the Cord to a standard string.

methods.name: CopyCordToString
methods.description: Copies the contents of a Cord into a std::string.

methods.name: Cord::FlattenSlowPath
methods.description: Converts a Cord into a flat representation, allocating memory if needed.

methods.name: Cord::SetCrcCordState
methods.description: Sets the CRC state for the Cord, used for integrity verification.

methods.name: Cord::SetExpectedChecksum
methods.description: Sets the expected checksum for the Cord.

methods.name: Cord::MaybeGetCrcCordState
methods.description: Retrieves the CRC state if present.

methods.name: Cord::ExpectedChecksum
methods.description: Returns the expected checksum if set.
